name: Install HD cherry blossom overlay

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/install-hd-sakura.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  install:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install exact high-resolution sakura asset
        shell: python
        run: |
          import base64
          import pathlib
          import re

          encoded = (
              ""
              ""
              ""
              ""
              ""
              ""
              ""
              ""
              ""
              ""
          )
          asset_path = pathlib.Path("assets/sakura-overlay.webp")
          asset_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          asset_path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(encoded))

          css_path = pathlib.Path("styles.css")
          css = css_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

          pattern = re.compile(
              r'(\.sakura-corner\s*\{.*?background-image:\s*)url\("[^"]+"\);',
              re.S,
          )
          css, count = pattern.subn(
              r'\1url("assets/sakura-overlay.webp");',
              css,
              count=1,
          )
          if count != 1:
              raise SystemExit("Could not find the sakura background-image rule")

          css = css.replace("\n  image-rendering: auto;", "", 1)

          marker = "/* HD sakura sizing overrides */"
          if marker in css:
              css = css[:css.index(marker)].rstrip() + "\n"

          css += r"""
          
          /* HD sakura sizing overrides */
          .sakura-corner {
            top: -72px;
            right: -92px;
            width: 430px;
            height: 574px;
            opacity: 0.68;
            background-position: top right;
            background-size: contain;
            background-repeat: no-repeat;
          }
          
          @media (max-width: 860px) {
            .sakura-corner {
              top: -58px;
              right: -102px;
              width: 350px;
              height: 467px;
              opacity: 0.56;
            }
          }
          
          @media (max-width: 620px) {
            .sakura-corner {
              top: -42px;
              right: -112px;
              width: 255px;
              height: 340px;
              opacity: 0.42;
            }
          }
          """
          css_path.write_text(css, encoding="utf-8")

      - name: Commit HD sakura asset
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add assets/sakura-overlay.webp styles.css
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes needed."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Install exact high-resolution cherry blossom overlay"
          git push
